The core contribution lies in establishing a connection between Clebsch-Gordan coefficients, commonly used in quantum mechanics, and Gaunt coefficients, which are integrals of products of spherical harmonics. This connection allows the authors to reformulate the tensor product of irreducible representations (irreps) as a multiplication between spherical functions represented by spherical harmonics.
